description: This file defines the ProductImageCropUtils class, which provides utility functions for cropping images based on specified dimensions, including calculating crop areas, determining crop feasibility, and extracting cropped image segments.

classes.name: ProductImageCropUtils
classes.description: Utility class for cropping images, encapsulating logic to determine crop feasibility, compute crop areas, and produce cropped image segments based on given dimensions.

methods.name: getCroppedImage
methods.description: Returns a cropped version of the original image either as a BufferedImage or as a temporary File, based on specified cropping parameters.

methods.name: determineCropeable
methods.description: Determines if the image can be cropped based on its dimensions and specifications, setting the cropeable flag accordingly.

methods.name: determineCropArea
methods.description: Calculates the crop area width and height, adjusting for image dimensions and aspect ratio considerations.

methods.name: getCropeBaseline
methods.description: Returns the baseline used for cropping calculations (not actively used in current code).

methods.name: setCropeable
methods.description: Sets whether the image is croppable.

methods.name: isCropeable
methods.description: Returns whether the image can be cropped.

methods.name: getCropAreaWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the calculated crop area.

methods.name: setCropAreaWidth
methods.description: Sets the width of the crop area.

methods.name: getCropAreaHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the crop area.

methods.name: setCropAreaHeight
methods.description: Sets the height of the crop area.
